dedupe_keys.name: dominican republic national protected areas system sinap maps and kmz layers

description: The Dominican Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources publishes downloadable maps of the National System of Protected Areas (SINAP) and a set of KMZ layers. The KMZ download page lists the national system of protected areas updated in February 2026 (3.38 MB), the green belt, the metropolitan protected areas and the buffer zones updated in February 2026 (4.31 MB), all posted in March 2026, with a download counter for each file; a separate page offers downloadable maps of the protected areas system, and the ministry also runs a geographic information system (SIGEO). Access is free online under the ministry site's terms of use, and no open licence is named on the pages read. Caveats: the layers are KMZ files meant for display in Google Earth or GIS, the attributes of each layer are not described on the page read, and the site is in Spanish. Coverage is the Dominican Republic, including the Santo Domingo metropolitan green belt. It supports green infrastructure planning and screening of roads, power lines and other projects against protected areas and buffer zones, and nature-based flood and coastal protection studies; related records are the AOPK Czech nature conservation data and the Swiss federal biodiversity inventories.
